title: Trance
tagline: Extended electronic builds and repeating melodies designed for immersive dance floors.
summary: Trance is electronic dance music built around repeating melodic phrases, gradual builds, and extended arrangements. The style developed in European club scenes and diversified into many substyles, from atmospheric to high-energy. DJs and producers use repetition and changes in texture to create a sustained, immersive dance experience.

pillars.name: Paul van Dyk
pillars.why: Paul van Dyk became a prominent figure in trance through influential productions and international DJ performances.

pillars.name: Sven Väth
pillars.why: Väth helped shape German electronic club culture and supported the development of trance and techno.

pillars.name: Robert Miles
pillars.why: Miles brought melodic, piano-led trance to a broad audience with internationally successful recordings.
